item.title: India Suffer Shock Injury-time Defeat Against Vietnam In Opener
item.description: Nguyen Thi Van Su: An injury-time goal condemned two-time runners-up India to a 1-2 defeat against Vietnam in their first match in Group C of the AFC Women’s Asian Cup Australia 2026 at the Perth Rectangular Stadium in Perth on Wednesday.

item.title: T20 WC: Mumbai's Weather And Pitch Report Ahead Of IND Vs ENG Semis Clash
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: The defending champions India will face two-time winners England in the second semi-final of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 to be played at the iconic Wankhede Stadium on Thursday.

item.title: PGTI NexGen 2026: Sukhraj Gill, Rajesh Gautam Share Lead After Round 2 In Phillaur Open
item.description: DP World PGTI NexGen Phillaur: Sukhraj Singh Gill and Rajesh Kumar Gautam held the joint lead at a total of five-under 137 after round two of the DP World PGTI NexGen Phillaur Open 2026, which will be played at the Ranjitgarh Golf Club in Phillaur, Punjab.

item.title: T20 WC: Chakravarthy Will Be The Most Dangerous Bowler Against Brook, Says Pujara
item.description: T20 World Cup: Wrist spinner Varun Chakravarthy's repertoire of variations, especially the googly, makes him the most potent threat to counter in-form England skipper Harry Brook in the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup semi-final, to be played at the Wankhede Stadium on Thursday evening, said former India batter Cheteshwar Pujara.

item.title: Arsenal Moves Seven Points Clear At Top Of Premier League
item.description: Premier League: Arsenal moved seven points clear at the top of the Premier League with a 1-0 win away to Brighton on Wednesday, while Manchester City was held to a 2-2 draw at home to Nottingham Forest.

item.title: T20 WC: 'It Wasn’t A Choke, It Was A Bloody Walloping,' Says SA Head Coach Conrad After Semis Defeat
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: South Africa's head coach Shukri Conrad made no excuses after his side crashed out of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 with a comprehensive nine-wicket defeat to New Zealand in the first semi-final played at Eden Gardens on Wednesday.

item.title: Leverkusen Edges Hamburg To Boost Champions League Push
item.description: UEFA Champions League: Bayer Leverkusen strengthened its push for UEFA Champions League qualification with a 1-0 win over Hamburger SV in a rescheduled Bundesliga match from the 17th round on Wednesday.

item.title: T20 WC: Flat Wankhede Pitch Could Even Out Advantage, Low Dew Promises Good Contest, Says Karthik
item.description: T20 World Cup: A flat red-soil pitch at the Wankhede Stadium could level the playing field between India and England rather than hand either side an edge in the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup semi-final, said former wicketkeeper-batter Dinesh Karthik.

item.title: Austria Arrive In Hyderabad For FIH World Cup 2026 Qualifiers Hyderabad, Telangana
item.description: FIH Hockey World Cup: The Austrian women’s hockey team touched down in Hyderabad ahead of the FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 Qualifiers Hyderabad, Telangana. The tournament will witness eight nations compete for three crucial qualification spots for the marquee event in Belgium and the Netherlands in August later this year.

item.title: ICC Chairman Jay Shah Meets J&K; Players After Historic Ranji Trophy Triumph
item.description: Hubli Cricket Ground: ICC chairman Jay Shah met members of Jammu & Kashmir's team after their historic Ranji Trophy win, in which they beat the eight-time champions Karnataka at the Hubli Cricket Ground on February 28 to win their maiden title.
